title: TCP connection state machine
goal: Show standard TCP establishment and close-state transitions.

rubric.must: CLOSED visibly branches to LISTEN for passive open and SYN_SENT for active open.
The SYN_SENT and SYN_RCVD states visibly reach ESTABLISHED through labelled SYN, SYN-ACK, and ACK transitions.
ESTABLISHED visibly proceeds through FIN_WAIT_1, FIN_WAIT_2, and TIME_WAIT on an active close.
ESTABLISHED visibly reaches CLOSE_WAIT then LAST_ACK before CLOSED on a passive close.
CLOSING and its transition to TIME_WAIT are visibly present.
TIME_WAIT visibly returns to CLOSED after a 2MSL timeout.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the state exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: Codex visual recheck: LAST_ACK connects along the right outer route to the right edge of CLOSED, labelled rcv ACK of FIN. TIME_WAIT connects along the separate left outer route to CLOSED, labelled 2MSL timeout. FIN_WAIT_1 also has its distinct FIN,ACK route to TIME_WAIT. The paths are not inverted.

items.evidence: CLOSED visibly branches to LISTEN with “passive open” and to SYN_SENT with “active open / send SYN”.
SYN_SENT reaches SYN_RCVD on “rcv SYN / send SYN,ACK” and ESTABLISHED on “rcv SYN,ACK / send ACK”; SYN_RCVD reaches ESTABLISHED on “rcv ACK”.
ESTABLISHED proceeds to FIN_WAIT_1 on “close / send FIN,” then FIN_WAIT_2 on “rcv ACK of FIN,” and TIME_WAIT on “rcv FIN / send ACK”.

Codex visual recheck: LAST_ACK connects along the right outer route to the right edge of CLOSED, labelled rcv ACK of FIN. TIME_WAIT connects along the separate left outer route to CLOSED, labelled 2MSL timeout. FIN_WAIT_1 also has its distinct FIN,ACK route to TIME_WAIT. The paths are not inverted.
FIN_WAIT_1 reaches CLOSING on “rcv FIN / send ACK,” and CLOSING reaches TIME_WAIT on “rcv ACK of FIN”.
